tei:div.tei:p: e ya/ bdag mdun bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas gsum ral gri tho ba gtun shing dang*// g.yon gsum lcags kyu sbrul zhags thong gshol bsnams// yum mchog dmar mos phur pa lcags drwa 'khyud/ khro chas yongs rdzogs me klong pad nyi'i steng*// yab kyi gnas lngar go cha lha lnga gsal// thugs srog hūm̐ la rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor// ye nas dam ye dbyer med dran rdzogs gsal// oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ king kang kha truṃ nṛ myog dgra bo wāka s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ bigh+naṃ' tra thuṃ te/ ti shan ti shan/ spur thuṃ spur brub/ bi sha tsakra ha la ha la/ sa ma ya/ dgra sri s+t+wam+bha ya rak+sha nan/ druṃ druṃ laṃ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/ oṃ kha thun kha thun/ ya ma ya ma/ dun tri dun tri/ pra le dz+wa la pra le dz+wa la/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la byur dang mi kha dgra gyod jag rkun gyi gnod pa srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ye swā hā/
zhes srung sngags ci nus bzla/ zhes a rā gas grwa slob rnams la kha ton rgyun khyer du sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
